title: MSFS Marketplace Update — NEW Airports & Scenery You Can’t Miss This Week! (PC)
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: New Microsoft Flight Simulator Airports and Scenery (Feb 22, 2026). Explore KSTL St. Louis, FMEE Réunion, and SkyTech Storm Weather Presets for PC today!

This week’s drop brings an exciting lineup of must‑have new airports and fresh scenery upgrades for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. If you fly on PC, this is a fantastic week to explore new destinations and visuals across the globe!

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 FSDG: FMEE Réunion Roland Garros International (A major Indian Ocean hub)
🛫 Realworld Scenery: KSTL St. Louis International Airport (Large US airport with lots of traffic)
🛫 South Oak Co: YMER Merimbula Airport (Scenic coastal airport in Australia)
🛫 VueloSimple: SABN Aeroparque Jorge Newbery (Popular Argentinian city airport)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Cli4D: Grosser Mythen (Beautiful mountain scenery)
🌆 DreamScenery: Night Enhanced – 2024 Exclusive Edition: Harrisburg, Warsaw, Vienna, Trenton, Jefferson, Salem, Santa Fe, Lansing, Charleston, Saint Paul, Carson & Sparks, Lincoln, Richmond, Topeka, Concord, Frankfort, Oklahoma
🌆 DreamScenery: Enhanced Road Lights: Cheyenne, Charleston, Carson City
🌆 SkyTech: Storm Weather Presets – Cyclone (Extreme weather presets)
🌆 SkyTech: Storm Weather Presets – Hurricanes (Severe storm presets)
🌆 SkyTech: Storm Weather Presets – Super Cells (Dramatic storm visuals)
🌆 SkyTech: Storm Weather Presets – Tropical Storms (Tropical system presets)
🌆 SkyTech: Storm Weather Presets – Typhoons (Intense weather effects)

If you enjoy this weekly roundup, don’t forget to drop a like, subscribe, and tell me in the comments which new airport or scenery you’re flying to first!
✈️ See you in the skies!
